semantic.justification: Extracts the existing bounded list label-alignment serializer into the native numbering-export source owner, preserving its conditions, fallback values and XML attribute output. For the existing LABEL_ALIGNMENT mode and LISTTAB/SPACE/NOTHING separators, source-owned xmlnumi parsing now retains zero defaults and MM100 fields with native Converter grammar/failure and SHRT bounds. The MM100 import port now carries both independent native geometry groups; the earlier legacy-to-alignment Twip emulation is removed. Writer numbering property conversion follows unosett.cxx signed MM100/Twip ratios; export projects native MM100 and delegates CM serialization to XML/SAX. ODF 1.3 XML emits explicit label-alignment mode and retains standard command geometry; indents are nonzero-only and tab position is exported only for LISTTAB with a positive value. Declared levels retain independent native legacy and alignment geometry with zero defaults; only exact label-alignment selects modern mode. SvxNumberFormat in editeng owns positional state, signed widths and mode-dependent getters; Writer inherits and copies all fields. xmlnumi owns level/property contexts and MM100 legacy parsing/assembly. Writer conversion precedes core application, and xmlnume emits the selected group with native signs and omission predicates. Clone and browser snapshots preserve inactive fields; primitive browser geometry selects the active group. No whole-module promotion.
